name: Esterwegen (Germany)
description: Square flag divided horizontally red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Esterwegen (a white tree and a cross on red).
history: Municipal flag of Esterwegen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Esterwegen arms — white tree and cross on red
